answer: On the high mesa where winds gale, each agent must carve a unique ivory token from a physical keycard bound to one human's biometrics. The system checks the token's hardware signature against a global registry of issued cards; duplicates fail. An attacker forging many agents would need to buy and spoof dozens of real keycards plus biometric forgeries, raising the cost far above any mining reward and making mass Sybil creation uneconomical.
